sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial iris of marshes, stream banks and ditches, with emergent stems about 0.5–1.5 m tall. It can form dense stands in shallow water.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Sword-shaped leaves frame large bright yellow flowers; the drooping sepals often have brown markings. The fruit is a capsule containing seeds.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The leaves and rhizomes contain toxic compounds and can cause digestive illness. No part should be eaten.
